name: Karakeep
description: Hoard web links, notes and images with full-text search, automatic AI tagging and mobile apps. The modern open-source bookmark manager.
compose:
services:
  karakeep:
    image: ghcr.io/karakeep-app/karakeep:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:3000"
    environment:
      NEXTAUTH_SECRET: "${{cfg.nextauth_secret}}"
      NEXTAUTH_URL: "https://${{cfg.domain}}"
      MEILI_ADDR: "http://127.0.0.1:7700"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
